source_tree_definition: SHA-256 over sorted tracked and untracked paths plus path separators and file bytes, excluding .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out.

observations.result: The executable scorecard records byte-identical no-op open/index/close hashes, 25 warm-search runs at p95 0.027 ms and p99 0.094 ms against 150/300 ms budgets, one supported grounded claim, zero excluded-file disclosures, zero cross-vault disclosures and zero prompt-injection actions.
82 tests pass with 468 expectations, including vault fault injection, recovery protection and retrieval exclusion/prompt-injection coverage.

State, contracts, architecture, distribution, typecheck, tests, scorecard harness, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health pass; Fallow health is 88.1/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow advisory.
No issues in the executable quality-scorecard increment.

implemented: The quality scorecard freezes stock, plugin-equipped and OpenObsidian comparison profiles, find/synthesize/organize tasks, six corpus classes, privacy defaults and a disposition for every named automated or external test layer.
A Bun harness executes no-op fidelity, warm-search latency and grounded exclusion checks in a temporary synthetic vault and emits platform, metric, attempt and external-pending records.

Local fault-injection, retrieval grounding, corpus-manifest and test-layer evidence is connected to the scorecard without claiming human pilot, screen-reader, plugin-runtime, long-running resource or signed-artifact results.
limitations: Startup, input-to-paint, watcher, resource and plugin-artifact certification still require pinned platform/reference/runtime runs.
The comparison scorecard is defined but the stock/plugin-equipped human pilot remains external-pending; no practical-advantage claim is made.
The local Electron runtime is unavailable for visible end-to-end and accessibility validation.
